canonicalReview.reconciliationSummary: Canonical review uses the single reviewer result from epic-reviewer-2.
crossStoryFindings: No blocking cross-story drift found. The SDK-only construction path from CLI retirement, inference assignment validation, adapter routing, failure classification, real-suite accounting, and turn-end boundary patch compose coherently.
Story 5 keyed real-inference evidence is present and matches the DoD: /tmp/lbuild-run/keyed-run-verbose.txt records RAN with openai/gpt-4o-mini and 13/13 passing.
architectureFindings: The inference adapter stays behind the existing DerivationProvider seam; domain handlers continue consuming provider operations and only copy provenance into metadata.
Import-boundary gate passed. The inference area does not import domains, and the inspect/domain boundary rules remain enforced.
The Story 6 AC-5.3 landing-window exception is reflected in the story and tech design, implemented in boundary grouping, and covered by focused tests.
epicCoverageAssessment: All 22 ACs and 15 TCs have story ownership in coverage.md and matching test files.
Default gate covers construction, routing, adapter prompts, classification, unkeyed real-suite accounting, boundary behavior, and CLI retirement.
Keyed real endpoint coverage is verified by the recorded keyed run; current default gates correctly show NOT-RAN when LHC_OPENROUTER_KEY is unset.
productionPathFindings: No material fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real production execution path found in the createSdk({ inference }) -> createInferenceProvider -> host ModelCall path.
OpenRouter transport is confined to test fixtures. Production source contains no fetch/API credential path.
The deterministic provider remains an explicit direct-injection provider for tests/custom use and is not a silent default.
